camera

系统相机。扫码二维码功能。相关 api：ma.createCameraContext

属性 类型 默认值 必填 说明 备注
device-position String back 否 摄像头朝向
resolution String medium 否 分辨率，不支持动态修改 Android 暂不支持
flash String auto 否 闪光灯，值为 auto, on, off
bindstop Eventhandle 否 摄像头在非正常终止时触发，如退出后台等情况
binderror Eventhandle 否 用户不允许使用摄像头时触发
bindinitdone Eventhandle 否 相机初始化完成时触发，e.detail = { maxZoom }
bindrecorderror Eventhandle 否 录像异常退出时触发，返回错误信息以及被停止的录像的存储路径

resolution

resolution 合法值 说明 备注
low 低 Android 暂不支持
medium 中 Android 暂不支持
high 高 Android 暂不支持

device-position 合法值

合法值 说明
front 前置
back 后置

flash 合法值

合法值 说明 备注
auto 自动
on 打开
off 关闭
torch 常亮 Android 暂不支持

bindrecorderror回调函数

参数

Object res

属性 类型 说明
errMsg String 录像异常停止的报错信息
tempVideoPath String 异常停止的录像视频存储路径
tempThumbPath String 异常停止的录像封面存储路径

示例代码


<camera device-position='{{position}}' flash='{{flash}}' style='width: 100%; height: 300px;' binderror='error'
        bindstop='stop' bindinitdone='initdone' bindrecorderror='recorderror'></camera>
<slider id='slider2' value='1' bindchange='slider2change' max='{{sliderMax}}' show-value step='1'
        style='margin-top:50px ;' />

<view class='button-group'>
  <button class='takephoto' type='primary' bindtap='takePhoto'>拍照</button>
  <button class='takephoto' type='primary' bindtap='startRecord'>录像</button>
  <button class='takephoto' type='primary' bindtap='stopRecord'>停止录像</button>
</view>

<view class='button-group'>
  <button class='takephoto' type='primary' bindtap='takePosition'>切换摄像头</button>
  <button class='takephoto' type='primary' bindtap='takeFlash'>打开闪光灯</button>
</view>

const format = (res) => JSON.stringify(res, null, 4);
Page({
  data: {
    src: '',
    showText: '',
    position: 'back',
    flash: 'off',
    videoSrc: '',
    sliderMax: 100,
    info: ''
  },
  slider2change(res) {
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    let zoom = parseInt(res.detail.value);
    ctx.setZoom({
      zoom: zoom,
      success: (res) => {
        console.log('设置zoom', res.zoom);
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        ma.showToast({
          title: '设置zoom成功',
          icon: 'success'
        });
      },
      fail: (res) => {
        console.log('设置zoom fail');
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        ma.showToast({
          title: '设置zoom失败',
          icon: 'error'
        });
      },
      complete: (res) => {
        console.log('设置zoom完成');
      }
    });
  },
  initdone(res) {
    this.setData({
      sliderMax: res.detail.maxZoom
    });
  },
  takePhoto() {
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    ctx.takePhoto({
      quality: 'high',
      success: (res) => {
        this.setData({
          src: res.tempImagePath,
          info: format(res)
        });
      },
      fail: (res) => {
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
      }
    });
  },
  takePosition() {
    if (this.data.position === 'front') {
      this.setData({
        position: 'back'
      });
    } else {
      this.setData({
        position: 'front'
      });
    }
  },
  startRecord() {
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    ctx.startRecord({
      timeoutCallback: (res) => {
        ma.showToast({
          title: '录像定时结束',
          icon: 'success'
        });
        this.setData({
          src: res.tempThumbPath,
          info: format(res)
        });
        this.setData({
          videoSrc: res.tempVideoPath
        });
      },
      success: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        console.log('录像启动成功');
        ma.showToast({
          title: '录像启动成功',
          icon: 'success'
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        console.log(res);
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        console.log('录像启动失败');
        ma.showToast({
          title: '录像启动失败',
          icon: 'error'
        });
      },
      complete(res) {
        console.log('录像启动完成');
        console.log(res);
      }
    });
  },
  stopRecord() {
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    ctx.stopRecord({
      success: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        console.log('录像结束成功');
        ma.showToast({
          title: res.tempVideoPath,
          icon: 'success'
        }),
          this.setData({
            src: res.tempThumbPath,
            info: format(res)
          });
        this.setData({
          videoSrc: res.tempVideoPath
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        console.log(res);
        this.setData({
          info: format(res)
        });
        console.log('录像结束失败');
        ma.showToast({
          title: '录像结束失败',
          icon: 'error'
        });
      },
      complete(res) {
        console.log(res);
        console.log('录像结束完成');
      }
    });
  },
  takeFlash() {
    this.setData({
      flash: 'on'
    });
  },
  error: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.errMsg);
    this.setData({
      info: format(e)
    });
  },
  stop: function(e) {
    console.log('camera stop:stopstop');
    this.setData({
      info: format(res)
    });
    console.log(e.detail.errMsg);
  },
  recorderror: function(e) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'camera recorderror',
      icon: 'error'
    });
    console.log(e.detail.errMsg);
    console.log(e.detail.tempThumbPath);
    console.log(e.detail.tempVideoPath);
    this.setData({
      src: e.detail.tempThumbPath
    });
    this.setData({
      videoSrc: e.detail.tempVideoPath
    });
    this.setData({
      info: format(e.detail)
    });
  }
});

Bug & Tip

  1. 同一页面只能插入一个 camera 组件
  2. 请注意原生组件使用限制
